data.name: Komal Katal
data.title: Senior Service Delivery Manager | Enterprise Operations & SRE Governance

summary.subtitle: Results-driven Enterprise Operations and Service Delivery Leader
summary.text: Results-driven Enterprise Operations and Service Delivery leader with 13+ years of experience in SRE Governance, Program Management, and Strategic Account Management across complex, high-availability environments. Built a product support function from the ground up at Mastercard, mentoring three team members to collectively manage 80 white-label enterprise accounts across APAC, NA, and EU, delivering 90–93% CSAT and ~95% SLA adherence. Proven track record in driving Operational Resilience, Benefits Realization, and Customer Retention through structured PMO practices, RAID Management, and data-led service assurance. Brings deep, working fluency in AI-powered tools, using them daily to build processes that improve team efficiency and speed up decision-making in live service environments.

experience.title: Senior Service Delivery Manager, Global Payments (MPGS)
experience.description: Owned and grew a $7–8 Mn global enterprise portfolio across 50+ merchants, driving retention, upsell, and cross-sell across Mastercard payment gateway, digital, and managed services products.
responsibilities: Owned and grew a $7–8 Mn global enterprise portfolio across 50+ merchants, driving retention, upsell, and cross-sell across Mastercard payment gateway, digital, and managed services products.

Owned a quantified KPI scorecard and SRE governance framework, continuously optimizing SLA performance, platform availability, and service responsiveness, achieving ~95% SLA adherence and 90% incident non-recurrence across enterprise operations.

Established observability-led service assurance practices by tracking performance trends, failure signals, and VoC data to proactively identify risks and drive remediation before customer impact, reducing TAT by 15-20%.
Built and maintained an operational resilience model for platform operations, reducing first-contact resolution gaps by 8-15% through structured root cause analysis and preventive governance.

Developed in-depth, hands-on expertise in customer transaction approval rates, diagnosing decline patterns and working directly with cardholders and merchants on root-cause resolution, directly increasing approval rates and revenue for key enterprise accounts.
As an AI enthusiast, actively design and use AI-powered tools and automation in daily workflows from operational signal analysis to service delivery optimization.

Joined as one of the first two team members of a newly formed function; built the entire service delivery operating model from zero, defining PMO practices, RAID management protocols, executive reporting cadences, and cross-functional governance frameworks.

Mentored and developed three team members into the program governance model, scaling portfolio management capacity to serve 80 white-label enterprise accounts across APAC, NA, and EU with full benefits realization tracking against each account.

Scaled a premium managed services offering across APAC and NA for six strategic enterprise clients, driving $1.2M in annual revenue through structured renewal management and proactive customer success practices.

experience.title: Major / Senior Manager – Service Delivery & Operational Management
experience.description: Owned large-scale IT service delivery and SRE governance across distributed, mission-critical enterprise environments, sustaining ~98–99% platform availability.
responsibilities: Owned large-scale IT service delivery and SRE governance across distributed, mission-critical enterprise environments, sustaining ~98–99% platform availability and improving operational resilience and delivery consistency by 15–20%.

Standardised platform operations through documented, repeatable workflows and service assurance frameworks, reducing dependency on individual expertise and enabling scalable, audit-ready operations at command level.
Drove cross-functional delivery of complex digital transformation and automation programs, achieving ~95% on-time execution and stable post-launch operations through structured PMO governance.

Led large, cross-functional technical teams and vendor-led operations end-to-end, owning people, assets, and migration delivery, achieving 90–95% on-time delivery and 10–15% efficiency gains across the portfolio.

Awarded GOC-in-C Commendation Card (2019) for leading the transition to digitally enabled, paperless operational workflows at command level, improving coordination, reducing execution latency, and ensuring consistent service delivery.
